end.summary:
• Asha practised decade, century and millennium vocabulary; Aarav gave the meanings as 10, 100 and 1,000 years.
• Naming the century of a year was practised; some answers were right, but it was not steady yet. The 1947/19th-century mix-up was corrected later in the lesson.
• Date differences were practised; easy questions were answered right, but a why or new-situation question is still to check.
• BCE ordering and subtraction remained uncertain, including the absence of a year 0.
end.parentNote: Asha practised time units, ordering BCE and CE dates, century labels, and finding how many years apart dates are. Aarav used the meanings of decade, century and millennium, and later corrected the 1947 mix-up by identifying it as 20th century; BCE subtraction and ordering still need practice. At home, use a number line to place BCE dates and practise two short date-difference questions, including one that asks why.
